label: D2 after a1 led rarely to S2, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 steps, and only where the agent chose a1 and the rare transition landed it in S2 (in_action=1, in_state=2). No activations at D1 or GO, none on a2 choices, none when the state is S1. Within that conjunction it is gated by how far into the episode the trial is: zero before trial 50, then the rate climbs steadily up to trial 99. The firing rate on a1->S2 rare D2 steps goes from about 26% overall to 60% when ep_trial >= 60. Adding ep_trial >= 60 is the simplest good predicate (dev F1 0.74, mass recall 0.99; ep_trial >= 50 gives recall 1.0 but precision 0.50). Gating by value-head output < 7.13 instead does slightly better (F1 0.78) but it uses the model output, so I did not record it. Previous reward, start_high and the hidden good state do not cleanly modulate it: about 86% of the mass is on good=S1 trials, but requiring good==1 hurts. Uses only observed inputs, so uses_future is false. Precision is the incomplete part, since many late a1->S2 rare steps stay silent, which is why the verdict is partial. I did not check magnitude in detail. The top activations are late-episode a1->S2 rare steps, often with a1 repeated across the whole window.
